$comment: Public pages only: read-only GETs, no auth, nothing billed per call. `expect` is text the healthy page always contains, so a parked domain or an error page served with 200 still counts as down. A service with `hostsFrom` checks https://<host>/ for every host in that repository secret and is up only when all of them are; its hosts never appear in this repository, status.json or the run log.
